## Course Overview
This upper‑division elective enrolled about 30 students. As the sole TA, I led discussion and lab sessions, graded coursework, and guided students through their regression projects. **I developed original materials**, including practice problems, exam questions, lab examples, and project guidelines, to enhance engagement and support independent learning.

*You can view sample teaching materials for this course using the links in the sidebar.*
:::
